surfaces.label: Server-side account/workspace/project authority
surfaces.notes: The diff does not alter grants, memberships, revocation, or authority decisions; archiveRoot is additionally removed from the local public project projection.

surfaces.label: Artifact and project ownership binding
surfaces.notes: Ownership tuples, capability binding, and artifact lookup paths are unchanged; cross-project credential tests pass after correcting fixture archive authority.

surfaces.label: Lease, generation, fence, and stale-result checks
surfaces.notes: Scheduler and fencing code is outside the changed production surface and the enabled hosted negative paths passed.

surfaces.label: Runtime isolation and default external-network denial
surfaces.notes: Runner network policy and controlled transport are unchanged. New compilation behavior remains inside operator-owned profiles and immutable worker graphs.

surfaces.label: Uploaded package, script, config, and plugin non-execution
surfaces.notes: Lucide export selection statically parses only the operator-owned profile barrel. Uno/forms and lock data remain data-only; no uploaded lifecycle, manager, config, or plugin is invoked.

surfaces.label: Lock identity, integrity, peer, and profile validation
surfaces.notes: Berry virtual/tag selectors now retain exact parent-scoped locations; Bun text peer metadata is strict and the binary-only unresolved optional-peer exception remains bounded.

surfaces.label: Path, public asset, archive, and symlink containment
surfaces.notes: Root-relative asset discovery is mapped only through the already validated publicDir and still passes safeArchivePath/realpath confinement. Export archive containment remains fail closed.

surfaces.label: Source and export immutability
surfaces.notes: The finite export compiler consumes immutable supplied modules in the resource-bounded worker; conditional inlining changes artifacts only and never project source.

surfaces.label: Secret and internal-path exposure
surfaces.notes: Public project output now strips archiveRoot in addition to root/sourceRoot; secret stores and redaction boundaries are unchanged.

surfaces.label: Admission, capacity, retry, cleanup, and timeout rules
surfaces.notes: No limits, deadlines, retries, or capacity controls were relaxed. Enabled failure-path tests exercised refusal, quarantine, and stale-result rejection.
